description: Two clients each broadcast a Timeout transaction for the same S8 decision. Per spec/ordering-rules.md §3.1 the canonical winner is selected deterministically so honest peers converge: confirmed-in-block > observed-by-quorum > lexicographically-smaller txid.
expected_winner_rationale: Neither is confirmed in a block; B is observed by the quorum and A is not, so tier-2 selects B regardless of the smaller txid of A.
notes: Mirrors double-spend-attempt.json but exercises the quorum tier rather than the txid tie-break. Consumed by tools/tx-simulator conformance test via engine PickConflictWinner.
